title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in Rajajinagar

content.rendered:
Looking for a container office in Rajajinagar that is ready for daily work and built to last? SAMAN Portable manufactures container offices for sale in Rajajinagar and delivers them across Bengaluru directly from our own factory at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099. As a manufacturer rather than a reseller, we build each unit on a steel frame, fit it out for office use, and hand it over ready to switch on at your site.

Container Offices for Sale in Rajajinagar

A container office is a steel office cabin built on an MS steel frame to IS 2062, fitted with a door, windows, wiring points, flooring and wall lining so it works as a usable office on arrival. In Rajajinagar we supply 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices for site offices, sales and admin rooms, security and supervisor cabins, and multi-room office setups. SAMAN builds and delivers each unit factory-direct.

Container office sizes we supply

We supply three standard footprints and customise the internal layout, door and window positions, and electrical points to suit your use. Indicative specifications:

SizeTypical useLayout
10ftSecurity cabin, single-desk site office, supervisor roomCompact single room
20ftSite office, sales/admin office, meeting roomOne open room or one cabin + wash area
40ftTeam office, multi-room office, combined office and storeMultiple cabins or partitioned rooms

Units can be placed side by side or stacked for a larger office where the site allows. For exact dimensions and a current quote, share your requirement and we will confirm the right configuration.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

Buying factory-direct means you deal with the people who build the unit, not a middleman. Every SAMAN container office is constructed on an MS steel frame to IS 2062 at our Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 facility, and the company holds ISO 9001:2015 certification for its quality system.

  • Factory-built quality: MS steel frame to IS 2062, made in our own Bengaluru factory.
  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. (The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty.)
  • Delivery: standard delivery from ₹3,000, with transit typically 3–5 days.
  • Returns: within 7 days of delivery or installation.
  • Customisation: choose size, partitions, door and window positions, electrical points and finish to match how you work.

Delivery and installation in Rajajinagar

We deliver container offices across Bengaluru, including Rajajinagar and the surrounding west Bengaluru areas. Units are built and finished at the factory, then transported to your site ready for placement. Standard delivery starts at ₹3,000 and transit is usually 3–5 days once your order is confirmed. Our team advises on access and positioning so the unit can be set down cleanly on a prepared, level base. Tell us your site address and access details and we will plan the delivery for you.

Get a container office quote in Rajajinagar

Tell us the size you need, how you will use it, and your Rajajinagar site address, and we will share specifications and a current price. Pricing depends on size, layout and finishing, so we quote per requirement rather than list a single figure. To order or to discuss options, call +91 88616 22859 or use the Send Enquiry form on our website. You can also browse the full range on our container office range.

FAQs


What sizes of container office can I buy in Rajajinagar?

We supply 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices in Rajajinagar. The 10ft suits a single-desk site or security cabin, the 20ft works as a standard site or admin office, and the 40ft suits team or multi-room offices. Internal layouts can be customised.


How long does delivery take to Rajajinagar?

Once your order is confirmed, transit is usually 3–5 days. Standard delivery starts at ₹3,000. We build and finish the unit at our Bengaluru factory before transporting it to your Rajajinagar site, ready for placement on a prepared base.


Can the container office be customised?

Yes. You can choose the size, internal partitions, door and window positions, electrical points and finish. Tell us how you plan to use the office and we will confirm a layout that fits your work and your site.


What warranty comes with a SAMAN container office?

Each unit carries 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 year figure is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.


How do I get a price for a container office in Rajajinagar?

Share your size, intended use and site address and we will send specifications and a current quote. Call +91 88616 22859 or use the Send Enquiry form. We quote per requirement because price depends on size, layout and finishing.


Do you deliver and install across Bengaluru?

Yes. We deliver across Bengaluru, including Rajajinagar and nearby west Bengaluru areas, direct from our Gopasandra factory. Our team advises on access and positioning so the unit is set down cleanly on a level base.

Under his guidance, Saman Portable has become a trusted name in container office solutions and turnkey prefabricated buildings across India and beyond.
